author: HannahLouis

title: From a Mental Health Professional
body: We really need more apps like these, where one’s self-care is truly prioritized and the UI is cute and user-friendly. What made me come here to give a review was when I started crying when I visited the Hall of Guardians. It made me truly realize (and showed me), as a licensed mental health professional, that maybe we aren’t the only ones carrying the burden of helping those in need. It lifted quite a heavy weight off my shoulders when I read the messages left behind. To the development team at Finch, please keep leaving this app free. You guys are doing an amazing job, and I can’t thank you for all those who really need this.

title: AWESOME
body:
So my friend sent me a micro pet one night and it was so cute so I decided to download the app for fun figuring I would just delete it the next day but I was so wrong… 

This app is cute, aesthetic and it always makes my day. It helped me with my time management, my daily routines and much more! I wake up everyday feeling very motivated unlike last time. Even me mom downloaded this app after getting sick and tired of me always talking about it. My mom hates apps like these cause they never work. But now it’s been a month and she is still using it everyday with a smile on her face. 😃

Great job guys keep it up! Looking forward for the next update!❤️❤️❤️

title: Suggestion on Providing Statistic on the Goals
body:
Hi Finch Team,

I enjoy very much having Finch app as my self care app and it di improve myself so much. I also would like Finch team to provide statistic on the goals we have did so that we can see what to improve more in the future or motivate us in what we are currently doing😊. 

If you do find this suggestion is good. Please make this statistic present for all and not just to the plus finch because im just a normal user. I really can’t afford the Finch Plus because life is so much harder for me just being a stay at home mother look after my kids. 

Im looking forward for the wonderful things in Finch app.

Until then, thank you for you time reading this.

Sincerely,
Nis & Mama Nis birb
